definitions.explanation: A condition that impairs normal physical or mental functions. Can range from minor to serious.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}で{学校|がっこう}を{休|やす}みました。
examples.english: I was absent from school due to illness.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{病気|びょうき}です。
{病気|びょうき}が{治|なお}って{良|よ}かったです。
examples.english: I'm glad your illness got better.

notes:
{病気|びょうき}になる means 'to get sick'. {病気|びょうき}が{治|なお}る means 'to recover from illness'.

Related:
- {病院|びょういん} (hospital)
- {病人|びょうにん} (sick person)
- {入院|にゅういん} (hospitalization).
